电流的磁场 · 3D 互动课件: Magnetic Field of an Electric Current · 3D Interactive Lesson
电流的磁场: Magnetic Field of an Electric Current
必修第三册 · 第十三章第 1 节「磁场 磁感线」（印刷页 p.104–108）: Required Book 3 · Ch. 13 Sec. 1 "Magnetic Fields and Field Lines" (printed pp.104–108)
B̂ = Î × r̂ · 环与螺线管 B̂ = n̂: B̂ = Î × r̂ · loop and solenoid B̂ = n̂
磁场看不见摸不着，怎么把它画出来、又怎么判断它的方向？: A magnetic field can't be seen or touched: how do you draw it, and how do you tell its direction?
通电导线周围有磁场: A current-carrying wire has a magnetic field around it
铁屑排列 → 画出曲线，切线 = 方向: Iron filings line up → draw curves; tangent = direction
一圈圈同心圆；右手握导线: Concentric circles; right hand grips the wire
穿环绕回的闭合曲线；右手握线圈: Closed curves through the loop and back around; right hand grips the coil
竖直导线周围是一圈圈同心圆: Concentric circles around a vertical wire
穿环绕回的闭合曲线，中间最强: Closed curves through the loop and back around, strongest in the middle
内部近似匀强，外部像条形磁体: Nearly uniform inside, like a bar magnet outside
看不见摸不着，凭什么说通电导线周围有磁场？: It can't be seen or touched, so how do we know a current-carrying wire has a magnetic field around it?
打开三块玻璃板上的铁屑: Turn on the iron filings on the three glass plates
三块玻璃板上同时出现一层铁屑，沿磁场方向排成链：直导线周围排成一圈圈的圆；读数: A layer of filings appears on all three plates at once, lining up in chains along the field: around the straight wire they form circles; reading 20.0 μT (I = 2.0 A, r = 2.0 cm)
教材 A2.1 + A2.2 + A2.3：通电导线周围存在磁场（奥斯特 182: Textbook A2.1 + A2.2 + A2.3: a current-carrying wire has a magnetic field around it (Oersted 1820); the field is invisible but real; iron filings in the field are magnetized into tiny compass needles and, when the glass plate is tapped, line up in chains along the field lines, so they can make the field visible.
奥斯特 1820：通电导线使小磁针偏转，第一次揭示电与磁的联系（教材 p.104: Oersted 1820: a current-carrying wire deflects a compass needle, the first link found between electricity and magnetism (textbook pp.104–105).
磁场客观存在、不用接触就起作用；铁屑在磁场里被磁化成小磁针，轻敲玻璃板后沿磁感线: The magnetic field is real and acts without contact; iron filings are magnetized into small needles and, after the plate is tapped, line up along the field lines (the demonstration method on p.106).
铁屑分布只是示意：真实演示要用很大的电流（或多匝线圈）才排得出来，本课读数一律按: The filing pattern is only illustrative: a real demonstration needs a very large current (or a multi-turn coil) to form it, while this lesson computes every reading at 2 A; the textbook first uses a bar magnet as a comparison and then a current-carrying straight wire, while this lesson goes straight to three current-carrying setups.
去掉这一步：磁场变成「看不见也说不清存在」的空话，后面所有磁感线都没有依据。: Skip this step and the magnetic field becomes empty talk, "invisible and unclear whether it exists", and none of the later field lines have a basis.
常考：奥斯特实验说明电流周围存在磁场（电流的磁效应）。: Often tested: Oersted's experiment shows a current has a magnetic field around it (the magnetic effect of current).
直导线周围的磁感线是什么形状？: What shape are the field lines around a straight wire?
拖动视角绕导线转一圈，看整族同心圆: Drag the view around the wire and see the whole family of concentric circles
磁感线是一圈圈的同心圆，全部落在与导线垂直的水平面上；绕导线转到任何一侧都还是同: The field lines are concentric circles, all in horizontal planes perpendicular to the wire; from any side of the wire they are the same concentric circles; reading 20.0 μT
教材 A2.7 原句：直线电流的磁感线是一圈圈的同心圆，这些同心圆都在跟导线垂直: Textbook A2.7: the field lines of a straight current are concentric circles, all in planes perpendicular to the wire; field lines close on themselves, and a drawing on paper shows only one plane of this family of circles.
B̂ ⊥ r̂，B̂ 沿绕轴圆周: B̂ ⊥ r̂, B̂ along the circle around the axis
纸面只是截面: The page is only a cross-section
同心圆，并且都在与导线垂直的平面上（教材 p.106 原句）。: Concentric circles, all in planes perpendicular to the wire (textbook p.106).
不是从导线沿半径射出去——那是点电荷的电场（A7.2 的错法）。: They don't radiate out from the wire along radii; that's the electric field of a point charge (the error in A7.2).
纸面图只是三维这一族圆的一个截面，绕轴转一圈才看全。: A drawing on paper is only one cross-section of this 3D family of circles; go all the way around the axis to see all of it.
去掉这一步：学生会照点电荷的样子把磁感线画成放射状。: Skip this step and students draw magnetic field lines radiating out like a point charge's.
常考陷阱：直导线周围的磁感线沿半径向外（A7.2）。: Common trap: field lines around a straight wire point radially outward (A7.2).
电流方向一反过来，磁感线的方向怎么变？: If the current reverses, how does the direction of the field lines change?
把电流拖到 −2.0 A（反向），盯住箭头和方向读数: Drag the current to −2.0 A (reversed) and watch the arrows and the direction reading
读数仍是 20.0 μT（大小不变），方向读数由「俯视逆时针」变成「俯视顺时针」: The reading is still 20.0 μT (same magnitude), the direction reading changes from "counterclockwise from above" to "clockwise from above", every arrow on the circles flips, and the B arrow at the probe turns around
教材 A2.7 原句：用右手握住导线，让伸直的拇指所指的方向与电流方向一致，弯曲: Textbook A2.7: grip the wire with your right hand with the extended thumb along the current, and the curled fingers point in the direction the field lines circle; reverse the current and the field at every point reverses. As a dot product: B̂·(Î×r̂) goes from +1 to −1.
右手握导线 · 图 13.1-7: Right hand grips the wire · Fig. 13.1-7
右手握导线：拇指沿电流、四指沿磁感线环绕方向。: Right hand grips the wire: thumb along the current, fingers in the direction the field lines circle.
电流反向 → 每一圈的绕向都反，而读数 20.0 μT 一点不变。: Reverse the current → every circle reverses direction, while the 20.0 μT reading doesn't change at all.
判据是 B̂·(Î×r̂)：反向前 +1、反向后 −1，不是「箭头掉头」那么简单: The test is B̂·(Î×r̂): +1 before reversal, −1 after; it's more than "the arrows turn around".
去掉这一步：学生以为反向只改磁场指向、不改环绕方向（A7.4 的错法）。: Skip this step and students think reversing changes only where the field points, not the direction it circles (the error in A7.4).
常考：安培定则用右手；「握导线」与「握线圈」两套手势的手指角色互换（A7.3、A: Often tested: Ampère's rule uses the right hand; "gripping the wire" and "gripping the coil" swap the roles of thumb and fingers (A7.3, A7.12).
离导线越远，磁场为什么越弱？: Why is the field weaker farther from the wire?
把探点拖到 4.0 cm，比较两处的疏密与读数: Drag the probe to 4.0 cm and compare density and readings at the two places
读数 20.0 → 10.0 μT（相对参考 1.00 → 0.50），相对地磁: Reading 20.0 → 10.0 μT (relative to reference 1.00 → 0.50), relative to Earth's field 0.40 → 0.20; the circles around the probe are clearly sparser
教材 A2.4：磁感线密的地方磁场强、疏的地方弱；直导线的 B 与到导线的距离成: Textbook A2.4: the field is strong where field lines are dense and weak where they are sparse; for a straight wire B is inversely proportional to the distance from the wire (extension level), so doubling r halves B. The same reading can be compared with the field-strength table on textbook p.110: 20 μT is only 0.40 times the average Earth field of 50 μT.
拓展 · 按毕奥–萨伐尔定律计算: Extension · computed with the Biot–Savart law
疏密表示强弱：密处强、疏处弱（教材 p.106 原句）。: Density shows strength: strong where dense, weak where sparse (textbook p.106).
r 从 2.0 到 4.0 cm，B 从 20.0 到 10.0 μT——变 1: r from 2.0 to 4.0 cm, B from 20.0 to 10.0 μT: it halves, not quarters.
20 μT 只有地磁场平均值 50 μT（教材 p.110）的 0.40 倍，真: 20 μT is only 0.40 times the average Earth field of 50 μT (textbook p.110); a real compass needle would be dominated by Earth's field, so this lesson uses iron filings.
去掉这一步：「疏密表示强弱」变成一句背下来的话。: Skip this step and "density shows strength" is just a memorized phrase.
常考：距离变 2 倍，直导线的 B 变 1/2。: Often tested: doubling the distance halves B for a straight wire.
环形电流的磁感线从哪里穿进去、又从哪里绕回来？: Where do the field lines of a circular current pass through, and where do they loop back?
拖动视角绕环转一圈，看磁感线怎么穿进去再绕回: Drag the view around the loop and watch how the field lines pass through and loop back
过环轴的每个平面里都是一族闭合曲线：环内穿过环面、环外绕回，没有一个断口；中心读: In every plane through the loop's axis there is a family of closed curves: through the loop inside, back around outside, with no breaks; center reading 25.1 μT, direction reading "toward +x end"
教材 A2.8 + 图 13.1-9：环形电流的磁感线是一族闭合曲线，从环的一侧: Textbook A2.8 + Fig. 13.1-9: the field lines of a circular current are a family of closed curves, emerging from one side of the loop and looping back to the other; use the other form of Ampère's rule: curl the fingers of the right hand along the current, and the extended thumb points along the field on the axis (the +x end in this lesson).
右手握线圈 · 图 13.1-10: Right hand grips the coil · Fig. 13.1-10
每条曲线都闭合：环内穿出、环外绕回。: Every curve is closed: out through the loop, back around the outside.
整族曲线绕环轴转一圈才是全部，纸面只有一个子午面。: The whole family of curves takes a full turn around the loop's axis; the page shows only one meridian plane.
右手握线圈：四指沿电流、拇指沿轴线——和握导线时手指角色正好互换。: Right hand grips the coil: fingers along the current, thumb along the axis, exactly swapping the roles from gripping a wire.
去掉这一步：学生会把环的磁感线画成上下两条直线，或者忘了它要绕回来。: Skip this step and students draw the loop's field lines as two straight lines above and below, or forget that they loop back.
常考：环形电流中心的磁场方向由安培定则（握线圈）判定（A7.6）。: Often tested: the field direction at the center of a circular current is found with Ampère's rule (gripping the coil) (A7.6).
把一匝变成十匝，中间的磁场变几倍？: Turn one loop into ten: how many times stronger is the field in the middle?
中心读数 25.1 → 251 μT（相对参考 1.00 → 10.00）；磁感: Center reading 25.1 → 251 μT (relative to reference 1.00 → 10.00); the shape of the field lines doesn't change at all, they just get denser and brighter
教材 A4.5 原句「通电螺线管可以看作许多匝环形电流串联而成」：每一匝对中心的: Textbook A4.5: "a current-carrying solenoid can be seen as many turns of circular current in series"; each turn's contribution at the center adds in the same direction, so B is proportional to the number of turns (B₀ = μ0NI/(2R), extension level), while the shape of the field lines stays the same.
多匝 = 串联的许多单匝，每一匝的贡献同向。: Many turns = many single turns in series, each contributing in the same direction.
形状不变，只有疏密变——强弱变了、几何没变。: Shape unchanged, only density changes: the strength changed, the geometry didn't.
去掉这一步：学生把「匝数」和「形状」搅在一起，以为多绕几圈磁感线会变形。: Skip this step and students mix up "number of turns" and "shape", thinking more turns deform the field lines.
常考：匝数加倍、电流不变，中心 B 加倍。: Often tested: double the turns with the same current and B at the center doubles.
沿轴线往外走，磁场怎样变弱？: Moving out along the axis, how does the field weaken?
把探点沿轴拖到 z = 5.0 cm（正好是环半径）: Drag the probe along the axis to z = 5.0 cm (exactly the loop radius)
读数 25.1 → 8.89 μT（相对参考 0.35）：z = R 处只剩中心: Reading 25.1 → 8.89 μT (0.35 of reference): at z = R only 0.354 of the center value remains; the direction reading is still "toward +x end", the arrow just gets shorter
轴线上处处 B̂ = n̂（同一方向，只是变弱）：B(z) = B₀/(1+(z: On the axis B̂ = n̂ everywhere (same direction, just weaker): B(z) = B₀/(1+(z/R)²)^{3/2}. At z = R the factor is 0.354 (25.13 → 8.89 μT), at z = 2R only 0.089.
轴线上处处沿轴：方向不变、只是变弱。: Along the axis everywhere: direction unchanged, just weaker.
去掉这一步：学生以为「离开环就没有磁场了」。: Skip this step and students think "there's no field once you leave the loop".
常考：由电流方向判轴线上各点的磁场方向（A7.14②）。: Often tested: finding the field direction at points on the axis from the current direction (A7.14②).
螺线管内部为什么近似匀强？管口外又弱到多少？: Why is the field inside a solenoid nearly uniform, and how weak is it outside the end?
把探点拖到管口 z = 6.0 cm，再拖到 10.0 cm 看管外: Drag the probe to the end at z = 6.0 cm, then to 10.0 cm to look outside
中心 8128 μT、管口 z = 6.0 cm 处约 4160 μT（理论 4: Center 8128 μT, about 4160 μT at the end z = 6.0 cm (theory 4156, about half), only 248 μT outside at 10.0 cm; the field lines inside are nearly parallel and evenly spaced, quickly spreading out near the end; N pole at the +x end
教材 A2.8 + A2.15 + 练习第 6 题：通电螺线管外部的磁场与条形磁: Textbook A2.8 + A2.15 + Exercise 6: outside, a current-carrying solenoid's field closely resembles a bar magnet's, and inside it is nearly uniform (field lines are evenly spaced parallel lines); inside, field lines run from S to N, so the thumb direction (+x end) is the N pole. At the end only half the coil contributes, giving about half the interior value (0.51).
内部近似匀强：磁感线平行、间隔相等（教材第 2 节的匀强磁场判据）。: Nearly uniform inside: field lines parallel and evenly spaced (the uniform-field criterion from Sec. 2 of the textbook).
中心 8128 μT、管口 4156 μT（0.51 倍）、管外 10.0 cm: Center 8128 μT, end 4156 μT (0.51 times), only 248 μT outside at 10.0 cm.
内部磁感线由 S 极指向 N 极，拇指方向（+x 端）就是 N 极——外部与条形: Inside, field lines run from S to N, so the thumb direction (+x end) is the N pole; outside it closely resembles a bar magnet.
去掉这一步：「内部匀强」与「外部像条形磁体」变成两句互不相干的话。: Skip this step and "uniform inside" and "like a bar magnet outside" become two unrelated statements.
必考（教材练习第 6 题）：内部比管口外强，依据是磁感线疏密。: Must-know (textbook Exercise 6): the field is stronger inside than outside the end, judged by field-line density.
考核：在螺线管上找到读数正好是内部一半的位置: Assessment: find the point on the solenoid where the reading is exactly half the interior value
把探点从中心往外拖，让读数落在约 4160 μT（内部 8128 的一半），保持: Drag the probe out from the center until the reading is about 4160 μT (half of the interior 8128), and hold for 10 s
读数降到约 4160 μT（理论 4156）时 z = 6.0 cm，正好落在管: When the reading falls to about 4160 μT (theory 4156), z = 6.0 cm, right at the end; the direction reading is still "toward N pole (+x end)"
考核没有新结论：半值位置就是管口——「内部匀强、管口一半、外部像条形磁体」三件事: The assessment has no new conclusion: the half-value point is the end; "uniform inside, half at the end, like a bar magnet outside" come together on one device; strength is always judged by field-line density (textbook Exercise 6).
课件设定 · 管口 z = 6.0 cm: Lesson setting · end at z = 6.0 cm
先把电流定在 2.0 A：B ∝ I，电流一变基准就变。: First fix the current at 2.0 A: B ∝ I, so changing the current changes the baseline.
中心读数 8128 μT 的一半是 4156 μT。: Half of the center reading 8128 μT is 4156 μT.
读数降到一半时 z = 6.0 cm——正好是管口，再往外就迅速衰减。: When the reading falls to half, z = 6.0 cm, exactly at the end; beyond it the field decays rapidly.
没有新结论：把前面八步用在同一台装置上就是全部。: No new conclusion: it's all the previous eight steps applied to one device.
考试里的满分答法：内部磁感线更密 → 内部更强；N 极 = 内部磁场指向的那一端: Full-marks answer in exams: field lines are denser inside → stronger inside; N pole = the end the internal field points to.
同心圆都在与导线垂直的平面上: The concentric circles all lie in planes perpendicular to the wire
右手示意：拇指沿电流 / 四指沿磁感线: Right-hand illustration: thumb along current / fingers along field lines
右手握导线：拇指沿电流、四指沿磁感线: Right hand grips the wire: thumb along current, fingers along field lines
右手握线圈：四指沿电流、拇指沿轴线: Right hand grips the coil: fingers along current, thumb along the axis
铁屑分布仅示意（真实演示需大电流）: Filing pattern illustrative only (a real demonstration needs a large current)
通电直导线周围的磁感线是: The field lines around a current-carrying straight wire are
从导线沿半径向外的直线: Straight lines radiating out from the wire
与导线垂直平面内的同心圆: Concentric circles in planes perpendicular to the wire
从 N 极出发到 S 极的曲线: Curves from the N pole to the S pole
教材 p.106：直线电流的磁感线是一圈圈的同心圆，这些同心圆都在跟导线垂直的平: Textbook p.106: the field lines of a straight current are concentric circles, all in planes perpendicular to the wire.
只把直导线里的电流方向反过来，下面哪一项会变？: If only the current direction in a straight wire is reversed, which of the following changes?
磁感应强度的大小: The magnitude of the magnetic flux density
磁感线的形状: The shape of the field lines
每一点磁场的方向: The field direction at every point
教材 p.106：改变电流的方向，各点的磁场方向都变成相反的方向；大小与形状不变: Textbook p.106: reverse the current and the field direction at every point reverses; magnitude and shape stay the same (B̂·(Î×r̂) goes from +1 to −1).
